latestPosts.caption:
This weeks podcast guest is @_mitchhutch 

For those who may not know, Mitch completed Project Limitless - Swimming, Cycling & Hiking 13,000km from England to Summiting Mount Everest. 

We discuss the power of the body and the mind when you put it to the test, how to keep going and how to adapt and overcome the task at hand whether that’s physical or mental. 

If you want to be inspired, give this one a listen.
